analysis_options.api: Direct ActionNameVars::perform invocation over a synthetic per-case Funcdata body, then direct PrintC::emitLocalVarDecls through a FixturePrintC subclass (Ghidra) / PrintC::snapshot_local_scope + emit_local_var_decls (Rugra); no ActionGroup or other Action runs
analysis_options.funcdata: Locked BfdArchitecture over the pinned Git-blob curl input supplies Ghidra Funcdata, address spaces, TypeFactory, and the ScopeLocal. Each Ghidra case clears prior state via fd.clear(); Rugra builds an isolated synthetic Funcdata per case with an ActionRestructureVarnode-built ScopeLocal.
analysis_options.ir: Register leaves are SSA inputs; outputs are written register-space Varnodes defined by COPY(const) ops at explicit code addresses, each with a unique-space reader COPY. HighVariables are assigned by setHighLevel before the Action runs.
analysis_options.normalization: No Ghidra/Rugra behavior difference is normalized or removed. Pointer/Arc addresses, ScopeLocal symbol indices, and dynamic-symbol hashes are internal identities and never appear in the records. The $$undef symbol name is pinned by renameSymbol/rename_symbol to $$undef0000000a on both sides so the record never depends on the symbol-id counter. The captured declaration text has its outer whitespace stripped and inner line breaks replaced with '~' identically on both sides (transport normalization only).
analysis_options.random_seed: none; ActionNameVars, emitLocalVarDecls, and fixture construction are deterministic
